rounds.text: Merritronix Ltd demonstrates superior operational efficiency, evidenced by an ROE of 30.31% and an ROA of 16.63%, both of which significantly outperform their respective sector benchmarks of 24.78% and 12.56% [E7, E8]. This high level of capital productivity is further supported by a P/B ratio of 4.75x, which sits at a substantial discount to the sector benchmark of 9.67x [E6]. The market currently prices the stock at 35% of its 52-week range, suggesting that the valuation has not yet fully reflected the company's strong internal performance metrics [E4]. Furthermore, the reverse DCF analysis indicates that the current market price implies an earnings growth rate of 17.2%, which is well-aligned with the base case assumption of 18.0% [E36]. Conceded: [E3] and [E47]. Despite the lack of dividend yield, the intrinsic value calculated by the DCF model at Rs 373 provides a margin of safety over the current market price of Rs 354 [E3, E34, E35].
